$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (environments-and-promotion). Declares two schemas: `environment` (named target/source connectivity metadata, wraps an existing `source` object per design.md Decision 1/2 — no new credential or connection format) and `promotion_audit` (append-only/immutable log schema, matching call_log/job_log's x-openregister-archival convention). Also seeds two `environment` rows (`local`, `acceptance`) plus their connectivity `source` rows via `components.objects` + `@ref:<schema>:<slug>` tokens — the SAME mechanism OpenRegister's ImportHandler::resolveSeedReferenceTokens()/importFromJson() object-import loop already processes for every other OpenConnector register fragment's seed rows (verified live against OpenRegister HEAD: lib/Service/Configuration/ImportHandler.php lines ~1946-2030 processes `components.objects` with `@ref:` token resolution INSIDE importFromJson(), called from importFromApp(), which InitializeRegister.php invokes on every occ app:enable/upgrade). Deliberately NOT using `lib/environments.seed.json` (tasks.md's literal suggestion, 'following lib/sources.seed.json convention') or a schema-embedded `x-openregister-seed` array (the convention hitl-approval-rule-action.json used): neither is consumed by any code path in this app or in OpenRegister — `lib/sources.seed.json` has zero PHP references anywhere in lib/, and `x-openregister-seed` is only preserved as a round-trippable Schema config key (lib/Db/Schema.php RESERVED_KEYS) with no importer reading it back out. Following either literal precedent would have shipped a second, orphaned seed file (the exact 'spec-says-done, feature-never-runs' defect class this fleet actively guards against) instead of materialising the two seed environments design.md's Seed Data section requires.

environment.title: Environment
environment.summary: A named OpenConnector environment (e.g. staging, production) reachable via an existing Source
environment.description: Named environment metadata used by the promotion workflow (environments-and-promotion). Carries NO credential or connection material of its own — `sourceRef` points at an existing `source`-schema object (type: api) whose `location` and `configuration.authentication.credentialRef` describe how to reach that environment's OpenConnector API, so dispatching a call to an environment reuses CallService::call() and BrokeredCallService's existing broker resolution unchanged. See openspec/specs/environments-and-promotion/spec.md#requirement-named-environments-are-openregister-objects-that-wrap-an-existing-source-for-connectivity-req-001.

slug.description: Machine-readable, unique identifier used to address the environment in the promotion API (e.g. "production")
slug.title: Slug

role.description: UI-filtering hint only (design.md Open Questions): whether this environment is typically promoted FROM, promoted TO, or both. Not enforced at promotion time — any environment may technically be used as source or target, matching how Sources aren't role-locked today either.
role.title: Role

sourceRef.description: UUID of an existing `source`-schema object (type: api) describing how to reach this environment's OpenConnector API — location + optional configuration.authentication.credentialRef. SET_NULL (not CASCADE) so a deleted Source leaves the environment row intact but unusable as a promotion target (REQ-001 scenario 2: rejected with an actionable error naming the missing sourceRef, not a cascaded delete).
sourceRef.title: Connectivity Source

description.description: Optional free-text description of the environment
description.title: Description

promotion_audit.title: Promotion Audit
promotion_audit.summary: Append-only audit record of one promotion attempt (success or failure)
promotion_audit.description: One row per confirmed promotion attempt (REQ-006). Records who promoted, what configuration, from which environment to which, when, the outcome, a counts-only preview summary (never entity payloads or credential values), how many credentialRef rebindings were applied, and the CallLog id the underlying CallService::call() dispatch produced (Decision 2/4 cross-reference). appendOnly/immutable, matching call_log/job_log. See openspec/specs/environments-and-promotion/spec.md#requirement-every-promotion-attempt-is-recorded-in-an-append-only-promotion-audit-log-req-006.

actorUid.description: Nextcloud user id of the operator who confirmed the promotion
actorUid.title: Actor

configurationId.description: The OpenRegister configuration group id that was promoted
configurationId.title: Configuration ID

fromEnvironmentSlug.description: Slug of the source environment (always the local instance)
fromEnvironmentSlug.title: From Environment

completedAt.description: Timestamp the promotion attempt completed (success or failure)
completedAt.title: Completed At

message.description: Actionable failure detail when outcome is failed/rejected; empty on success
message.title: Message

previewSummary.description: Counts and slugs only (never entity payloads or credential values): number of creates/updates/collisions and the entity slugs written, mirroring the target's own preview classification at the time of promotion
previewSummary.title: Preview Summary

credentialRebindCount.description: Number of credentialRef placeholders that were rewritten via operator-supplied credentialBindings for this promotion
credentialRebindCount.title: Credential Rebind Count

callLogId.description: UUID of the CallLog OpenRegister object created by the underlying CallService::call() dispatch (Decision 2/4), so an operator can pivot from this audit entry to the raw CallLog when diagnosing a failed promotion
callLogId.title: Call Log ID

objects.name: Local Environment API
objects.description: Connectivity Source for the 'local' environment — this OpenConnector instance's own API, seeded so a fresh install has at least one usable promotion source environment.

objects.name: Acceptance Environment API
objects.description: Connectivity Source for the 'acceptance' environment — a pre-production OpenConnector instance. Authenticates via a credentialRef placeholder (never an embedded secret); the referenced credential must be created in the OpenRegister credential broker before this Source is used for a real promotion.
